steps.text:
Press here to generate 
a new human.

<- Drag the card to
the Parent slot ->
to select them
for recombination.

Click again to generate a new human to drag into the second Parent slot. →

You can also use the same parent in both slots: the offspring will still recombine, and not be identical!

You can drag alleles
from the Allele Bank ->
to the parent slots to modify the parent genotypes!

The Punnett Square  ->
shows the likelihood of different phenotypes.

Choose which genes to show by clicking the checkbox in the Allele Bank.

Press the "Recombine" button to generate an offspring!
Press the "Save to Library" and give them a name, or hit recombine again for a different offspring!
